economy.summary: Supports a pro-growth agenda focused on creating American jobs for American workers and bringing family-sustaining jobs to Pennsylvania. Serves on the House Small Business Committee and frames his economic work around supporting workers, farmers, small businesses, and countering the Chinese Communist Party.
economy.short: Supports pro-growth agenda, creating American jobs, supporting small businesses.

taxes.summary: Voted for H.R. 1, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, in July 2025, saying that by passing it Congress prevented the largest tax hike in American history and rooted out waste, fraud, and abuse in Medicaid.
taxes.short: Voted for 2025 tax bill; says it prevented largest tax hike.

abortion.summary: Describes himself as pro-life, citing a medical-school pledge to never perform, assist, or facilitate an abortion. A member of the Congressional Pro-Life Caucus, he has cosponsored the Defund Planned Parenthood Act, the Title X Abortion Provider Prohibition Act, and other bills restricting federal abortion funding.
abortion.short: Pro-life; cosponsored bills defunding Planned Parenthood, restricting abortion funding.

education.summary: Voted yes on passage of H.R. 5, the Parents Bill of Rights Act, which establishes rights of parents and guardians regarding their children's elementary and secondary education as a condition of federal education funds.
education.short: Voted for Parents Bill of Rights Act on parental education rights.

healthcare.summary: Says he works to protect Medicare, combat the drug crisis, and strengthen the pipeline of doctors through his Homegrown Health Care Initiative. In April 2026 he introduced the Medicare Advantage Improvement Act, bipartisan legislation to strengthen the Medicare Advantage program.
healthcare.short: Works to protect Medicare, combat drug crisis, strengthen Medicare Advantage.

energy.summary: Says he is working to roll back burdensome regulations, lower energy costs, and create energy jobs in Pennsylvania. Authored H.J.Res. 88, signed into law in June 2025, reversing California's electric vehicle mandate, and the RED Tape Act, which passed the House in April 2026 to eliminate a duplicative environmental review process.
energy.short: Works to roll back energy regulations; reversed California EV mandate.

guns.summary: Opposed H.R. 8, which would expand background checks to all firearm sales, calling such bills unnecessary burdens on the Second Amendment rights of legal gun owners, and cosponsored the Mass Violence Protection Act focused on law-enforcement coordination and prosecution.
guns.short: Opposed expanded background checks; defends Second Amendment rights of gun owners.

economy.summary: Pledges to address the cost of living by substantially increasing the federal minimum wage, increasing the availability of affordable housing, expanding property tax and rent rebates, and ending what she calls the union-busting ability of large corporations to restore collective bargaining.
economy.short: Proposes raising minimum wage, expanding affordable housing, restoring collective bargaining.

taxes.summary: Pledges to sharply reduce tax cuts for the ultra-wealthy and redirect funds toward assistance programs; also supports ending Citizens United to reduce corporate influence over elected officials.
taxes.short: Proposes reducing ultra-wealthy tax cuts; supports ending Citizens United.

abortion.summary: Pledges to enshrine reproductive freedom into federal law, including abortion, birth control, IVF, and gender-affirming care. Also supports national sex-education standards and required clear labeling of crisis pregnancy centers.
abortion.short: Supports enshrining abortion, birth control, IVF rights into federal law.

education.summary: Supports federal funding to even out disparities affecting poorly resourced school districts and opposes using tax dollars to fund private or parochial schools through vouchers or any other mechanism; supports instruction delivered by licensed professional educators.
education.short: Supports federal public-school funding equity; opposes private school vouchers.

healthcare.summary: Pledges to enshrine into federal law a national healthcare program so all treatments and preventative care are covered regardless of age, employment, or pre-existing conditions. Opposes the One Big Beautiful Bill Act's Medicaid changes and supports expanding licensed healthcare, including maternity care, in rural areas.
healthcare.short: Proposes national universal healthcare program; opposes 2025 Medicaid changes.

energy.summary: States that climate change is real and pledges to reduce fossil fuel dependence, expand renewable energy including solar, wind, geothermal, and hydro, reduce methane emissions, make electrification affordable through tax incentives, and support advanced nuclear technologies such as small modular reactors.
energy.short: Supports expanding renewables, reducing fossil fuels, advanced nuclear technologies.

guns.summary: Supports federal gun-safety legislation including universal background checks, safe-storage requirements (Ethan's Law), lost-and-stolen firearm reporting requirements, and extreme risk protection orders.
guns.short: Supports universal background checks, safe storage, extreme risk protection orders.
